videoDetails.title: Pi Durable PROACTIVE Agents: Jev Triggers My ON-CALL Pi Agent
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Engineers... your agents are LAZY. 😲 They sit in a terminal and wait for YOU to prompt them. The future belongs to PROACTIVE agents: durable agents that don't wait for you to work. They work for you, then wait. Mario and Armin just dropped Pi Durable, and it changes how you build long-running agents.

🔥 PHASE 3 Early-Signup
https://agenticengineer.com/ia3-pre-launch?y=DNDYYHsypZg

🎥 VIDEO REFERENCES
• Pi Durable PROACTIVE Agent Codebase: https://github.com/disler/durable-pi
• Ten Levels Of JEV For Agentic Engineers: https://youtu.be/_U-O5lYhJ7Q
• Pi Durable Release: https://earendil.com/posts/pi-durable/

🚀 In this video, we break down Pi Durable, the new release from the creators of the Pi coding agent. A durable Pi agent persists your ongoing work, conversations, and application state through failures, through clients, and through change itself. I have durable agents running right now on my M4 Mac Mini, my M6 Mac Mini, my M5 MacBook Pro, and exe.dev cloud sandboxes, all connected in one durable agent network.

🔥 Watch as a JEV classifier detects a production incident in a live log stream and triggers an ON CALL Pi agent. The agent detects, investigates, finds the root cause, writes the fix, and waits for my review. Human near the loop: I approve, it deploys, production stabilizes. JEV classified hundreds of events for pennies. This is what agentic engineering looks like when your agents are proactive.

🛠️ Key takeaways:

Proactive Agents: The most valuable agent is the one that doesn't need you to ship. Trigger agents from real events and let them start the work before you show up.

Multi-Client Agents: Detach your agent from your UI. Connect from a browser, a TUI, curl, your phone, or your product. Same agent, many clients.

Shared Durable State: One shared application state object that every agent session on a device can read and update.

Durable Tasks: Repeatable jobs with phases you can resume, with sub-agents that ask for approval. Human near the loop, not stuck in the loop.

Live Harness Engineering: Swap tools mid-session, toggle extensions like JEV damage control on the fly, fork agents, and run background compaction.

💡 Anthropic and OpenAI are already building on durable agent primitives for products like OpenAI Dots and Claude in Slack. Claude Code and Codex showed us the first version. Pi Durable lets YOU own this layer. We already rent our intelligence. Don't rent your agents, your agent harness, and your durable agents too.

🌟 The next leap is phase three agentic engineering: moving from in loop to human near the loop to human out the loop. Track one KPI: how many agents are doing useful work for you right now, without you?

Stay focused and keep building.
